commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Ruby
commitResults.messageBody: Align the Java entry point and user documentation with the Ruby product name, and replace the old Duke output with the selected Big Money-ne startup banner.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add initial Ruby greeting and farewell
commitResults.messageBody: Print the chatbot banner, introduction, prompt, separators, and closing message so the starter application greets the user and exits as required.
Add a command-reading loop and extract terminal formatting into Ui so Ruby echoes complete input lines, prints a farewell for bye, and exits cleanly.
Store up to 100 task descriptions, acknowledge newly added tasks, and display the current tasks with one-based numbering while keeping the chatbot active until bye.
Represent tasks with completion state, parse one-based mark and unmark commands, and display status icons in numbered task listings and confirmations.
Parse todo, deadline, and event commands into inherited task types and format confirmations and listings according to the required UI output.

Record exact console UI expectations, add a fail-fast Java 25 test runner, and require UI regression checks after code updates. Include the visual-diff skill so both reusable review workflows are available from the repository.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid commands with Ruby exceptions
commitResults.messageBody: Validate task descriptions, date delimiters, command names, and task numbers so malformed input produces specific recoverable errors without changing task state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task deletion with collection storage
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the fixed task array with an ArrayList, support validated delete commands, and verify task removal, counts, and index shifting through UI regression tests.

Move source files into the ruby package and document public APIs.

Update launch instructions and UI tests for the packaged entry point.

Record Git message limits to prevent future convention violations.
